# Project

MCP-TUI is a Go test client for Model Context Protocol servers, with an interactive bubbletea TUI and a scriptable cobra CLI. It connects over stdio, SSE and streamable HTTP, and exercises tools, resources, prompts, sampling, elicitation, roots, OAuth and spec-conformance checks.

## Type

CLI / simple / desktop distribution

## Key Technologies

Go 1.25, bubbletea + bubbles + lipgloss, cobra, modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk, golang.org/x/oauth2, testify, pwsh (test child processes), Node/npm (distribution wrapper, test servers)

## Domain Concepts

See `.claude/rules/glossary.md`.

## Team Conventions

- SSE connects with `context.Background()`, never the CLI timeout context.
- Every stdio command passes `config.ValidateCommand`.
- Child-process tests use pwsh; CI sets `MCP_TUI_REQUIRE_PWSH=1`.
- No MCP servers configured directly in this repo — route agent MCP access through slop-mcp.
